# stackit_service_enablement (Data Source)

Service enablement datasource schema.

~> This datasource is in beta and may be subject to breaking changes in the future. Use with caution. See our [guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/stackitcloud/stackit/latest/docs/guides/opting_into_beta_resources) for how to opt-in to use beta resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stackit_service_enablement" "service_enablement_ske" {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  service_id = "cloud.stackit.ske"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID.
- `service_id` (String) The identifier of the STACKIT service. Possible values are: `cloud.stackit.ske`.

### Optional

- `region` (String) The resource region. If not defined, the provider region is used.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not the service is enabled in that region.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal datasource identifier. It is structured as "`project_id`,`region`,`service_id`".
